e-03.title: Sarudza zvekubvunza usati wapindura
e-03.goal: Sarudza ruzivo rwaunoda chaizvo usati wapindura meseji yekukoka, uye unyore mhinduro pfupi yechiRungu inorukumbira.
e-03.material:
'Wakagamuchira meseji kubva kushamwari yako Ari. "Let's play soccer tomorrow!"
Unofunga kuti zvinonzwika zvakanaka, asi meseji iyi yoga haikwani kusarudza kuti unogona kuenda here.'
e-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvaunofanira kuziva kuti upindure 'I can go.'
e-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kuti mhinduro yemubvunzo mumwe nemumwe inogona kuwanikwa here mumashoko.
e-03.s.s1.hint.1: Edza mubvunzo mumwe nemumwe: kana usina mhinduro yawo, ungati 'I'll come' here?
e-03.s.s1.r.a: Nguva inodiwa. Asi neichi chete, hauzive kwekuenda. Tarisa kuti pane chimwe chinodiwa here.
e-03.s.s1.r.b: Nzvimbo inodiwa. Asi neichi chete, hauzive kuti nguva yei. Tarisa kuti pane chimwe chinodiwa here.
e-03.s.s1.r.c: Bhora rakanaka kuva naro, asi harina kudiwa kusarudza kuti unogona kuenda here.
e-03.s.s1.r.d: Rinogona kubatsira, asi unogona kusarudza kuti unogona kuenda here pasina. Funga kuti ruzivo rwunodiwa chaizvo here.
e-03.s.s1.r.e: Ari akatoti let's play soccer. Izvi zvinobvunza zvauchatoziva.
e-03.s.s1.r.f: Kuziva chikonzero kwakanaka pakuda kuziva, asi hazvidiwi kusarudza kuti unogona kuenda here. Mubvunzo haudiwi nokuti unotanga neizwi remubvunzo.
e-03.s.s1.explain: Kana usingazivi nguva nenzvimbo, haugone kusarudza kuti inokodzera hurongwa hwako kana kuti unogona kusvikako here. Kana wasarudza imwe chete, edza zvakare: pasina imwe, ungati 'I'll come' here? (Kana uchiziva nguva chete, hauzive kwekuenda; kana uchiziva nzvimbo chete, hauzive kuti nguva yei.)
e-03.s.s1.acc.0: Zvakasikwa kuda kuziva kuti ndiani anouya zvakare. Asi pfungwa huru ndeyekuti haugone kupindura pasina nguva nenzvimbo.
e-03.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mhinduro kuna Ari muchiRungu. Ratidza kuti unoda kuzvibatanidza, uye isa mubvunzo unokumbira ruzivo rwawakasarudza pamusoro.
e-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga, nyora mashoko mapfupi anoreva 'Sounds good!'
e-03.s.s2.hint.1: Unogonawo kubatanidza mibvunzo miviri yawakasarudza kuita mutsara mumwe.
e-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mushure mekuverenga mhinduro yangu, Ari anogona kundiudza nguva nenzvimbo here?
e-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Inosanganisira mhinduro ine hushamwari nemibvunzo zvose here?

e-09.title: Usati wapindura 'Could you look at it at some point?' yemudiki
e-09.goal: Tsvaga ruzivo rwunoshaikwa muchikumbiro chisina kujeka, uye nyora mhinduro yeChirungu inosanganisira zvinobvunzwa zvaunoda nehunhu.
e-09.material:
Wakagamuchira meseji kubva kumudzidzi ari pasi pako negore rimwe. Munenge musingazivani.

"Hi! Sorry to bother you, but could you look at my essay at some point? Thanks!!"

Unoda kubatsira, asi une basa rakawanda vhiki ino.
e-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvaunofanira kuziva usati wapindura, kuti uzive kuti unogona kubatsira here uye ubatsire zvakanaka.
e-09.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mutsetse pasi pemazwi asina kujeka mumeseji, uye nyora mutsara mumwe pamwe nemumwe wekuti nei izwi iroro rinoita kuti sarudzo yako ive yakaoma.
e-09.s.s1.hint.1: Edza mubvunzo mumwe nemumwe: kana usina mhinduro, unogona kuti 'Yes, I'll do it' here?
e-09.s.s1.r.a: Deadline inodikanwa. Asi kubva pane izvi hauzivi kuti rubatsiro rwerudzi rupi rwunodikanwa. Tarisa kuti pane mumwe mubvunzo waunoda here.
e-09.s.s1.r.b: Rudzi rwerubatsiro runodikanwa. Asi kubva pane izvi hauzivi kuti rwunofanira kuitwa pakazosvika rinhi. Tarisa kuti pane mumwe mubvunzo waunoda here.
e-09.s.s1.r.c: Kureba kunodikanwa kuti ufungidzire nguva. Tarisa kuti mimwe mibvunzo inodikanwawo here.
e-09.s.s1.r.d: Mamaki egore rapfuura haabatani zvakananga nokuti unogona kubatsira here nechinyorwa ichi, kana kuti sei.
e-09.s.s1.r.e: Kuti ane rimwe rubatsiro here hakuchinji kuti unogona kubatsira here, kana kuti sei.
e-09.s.s1.explain: 'At some point' haina kujeka pamusoro penguva, uye 'look at' haina kujeka pamusoro perudzi rwerubatsiro. Unofanira kuziva deadline, rubatsiro rwunodiwa, nekureba kuti usarudze kuti unogona kuwana nguva here. Kana wakasarudza vamwe chete, edza kuti ungabatsira here pasina mhinduro yemubvunzo wawakasiya.
e-09.s.s1.acc.0: Deadline nerudzi rwerubatsiro rwunodiwa ndiwo mapoinzi akakosha, uye kureba chinhu chauchaziva mushure mokugamuchira, saka kuchisiya kwakanaka.
e-09.s.s1.acc.1: Zvakanakawo kutanga wasarudza nedeadline nekureba kuti unogona kuwana nguva here, uye ubvunze rudzi rwerubatsiro gare gare.
e-09.s.s1.acc.2: Kunyange une basa rakawanda vhiki ino, unogona kutanga wafungidzira kuti unogona kubatsira here kubva pamarudzi erubatsiro rwunodikanwa nekureba. Asi uchafanira kuziva deadline nokukurumidza.
e-09.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mhinduro kumudiki muChirungu. Ratidza nehunhu kuti wakagadzirira kubatsira, uye uise mibvunzo inosvika 2 yawakasarudza pamusoro.
e-09.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza mibvunzo miviri yaizochinja kuti unogona kubatsira here, kana kuti sei.
e-09.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora mubvunzo mumwe pamutsara mumwe, uye uise chirevo chekubatsira pakutanga chaiko.
e-09.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Sure, I'd be happy to help! ...
e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mushure mekuverenga mhinduro yangu, mudiki anogona kundiudza deadline nerubatsiro rwaanoda here?
e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Unogona kuona chishuvo chekubatsira nemibvunzo zvose here?
e-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Hunhu hwekutaura hwakakodzera munhu waunenge usingazivi here?
e-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Chimiro chine hunhu zvikuru uye chakananga.

e-10.title: Kurambira nehunhu, kana pachine mukana?
e-10.goal: Sezvo mutsara wese weemail ine hunhu uchiratidzwa, vandudza kutonga kwako pamusoro pechinangwa chaicho chemumwe munhu, uye nyora mhinduro inokodzera.
e-10.material: Wakatumira chikumbiro chekugadzira gadheni remiriwo yechikoro kuna Ms. Rowe, anotarisira chikoro. Email yemhinduro inovhurwa mutsara mumwe panguva.
e-10.prereq.0: Mazwi akaita se unfortunately, budget, estimate
e-10.s.s1.prompt: Verenga email chidimbu chimwe panguva, uye nguva imwe neimwe sarudza kutonga kwako kwekuti chikumbiro chichagamuchirwa here.
e-10.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti mutsara mutsva unochinja zvinoreva zvekare here kana kuenderera.
e-10.s.s1.hint.1: Isa mucherechedzo pamazwi anochinja kuyerera (But) nemazwi akananga akaita senzvimbo dzenguva nezvinangwa.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru kubva pamutsara uyu woga ndekupi?
e-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Kurumbidza woga hakuratidzi sarudzo. Kunogona kuva kutanga kwekurambira nyoro, kana kwaziso chete. Mutsara unotevera wakakosha.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Interesting' kurumbidza, asi haisi izwi resarudzo kana kubvuma.
e-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hatigoni kuziva sarudzo ichiri, uye tinofanira kuona mutsara unotevera.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Chirevo chehuwandu 'this year' chakakosha. Kana wakaverenga se 'kurambira nehunhu' pakutanga, mutsara uyu unotsigira kuverenga uku, asi hausati uri kurambira kusingaperi.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inoti gore rino rakaoma, uye haisati yataura chinhu pamusoro pezvichaitika gare gare.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Zvinoreva kurambira zvachose kubva zvino, zvisingabatani negore rino.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Yakataura 'this year's budget' chete. Haina kutaura kurambira kusingaperi.
e-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Idambudziko rebudget chete, saka richagadziriswa nokukurumidza uye tinogona kutanga gore rino.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Verenga kusvika kumutsara wekupedzisira uye utonge zvakare.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Kuyerera kunochinja ne 'But', uye deadline (Friday), chinangwa (director), nenguva (March) zvakananga. Kunyange wakaiverenga se haisati yasarudzwa kana chinangwa chekuenderera mberi, kana wakange wasarudza zvakasimba pa 'kurambira nehunhu' kare, unofanira kuvandudza kutonga kwako.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hunhu chete, saka hapana chikonzero chekupindura.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Munhu anoda kurambira chete haapi deadline (Friday) nechinangwa (director, March) mune zvakadzama.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Haasati asarudza kuti anorambira here, uye ari kuunganidza ruzivo kuti atonge.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uku zvakare kuverenga kunogoneka. Asi 'I will show it to the director before the March budget meeting' iri pedyo nokuda kuenderera mberi.
e-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Anofarira, uye ari kukumbira zvinhu kuitira kuti zviendeswe pamusangano webudget waMarch.
e-10.s.s1.reflect: Taura kuti kutonga kwako kwakachinja sei muchikamu chechitatu mushure mekutonga kuti 'difficult' muchikamu chechipiri. Mazwi api (But, by Friday, before ... March) akaita chikonzero?
e-10.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kuti kutonga kwako muchikamu chekutanga kwakasiyana sei nekutonga kwako muchikamu chekupedzisira (chechitatu), uye kuti mazwi api akaita kuti kusiyane. Unogona kunyora muKorean kana muChirungu. (Kana kusina kuchinja, nyora kuti nei kwakaramba kwakadaro.)
e-10.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga unyore nemutsara mumwe sarudzo yawakaita muchikamu 1.
e-10.s.s2.hint.1: Pakati pemazwi akatanga kuoneka muchikamu 3 (But, Friday, March, nezvimwe), sarudza rimwe rakachinja kutonga kwako.
e-10.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: At first I thought ... but because of ...
e-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakajeka kutonga kwawakasarudza kutanga here?
e-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasarudza uye wakanyora kuti izwi rei rinobva paemail rakachinja kutonga kwako here?
e-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Kana kusina kuchinja, wakatsanangura kuti nei uchishandisa zviratidzo zvinobva paemail here?
e-10.s.s2.model.0: At first I thought it was a polite refusal, but in the last sentence I saw that after 'But' she asked for an estimate by Friday, so I changed to thinking she is interested.
e-10.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro kuna Ms. Rowe muChirungu. Ratidza kutenda nekunzwisisa mamiriro, uye ipa chivimbiso chekutumira zvakakumbirwa pazuva rakakumbirwa (Friday).
e-10.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga zvakare zvinokumbirwa mumutsara wekupedzisira weemail (chii, uye pakazosvika rinhi) uye uzvitakure sezvazviri mumhinduro yako.
e-10.s.s3.hint.1: Edza kunyora nehurongwa uhu: mutsara mumwe wekutenda, mutsara mumwe wekunzwisisa, mutsara mumwe wechivimbiso.
e-10.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Thank you for your reply. ...
e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mhinduro yako yakapindura chaizvo chikumbiro chekupedzisira chaMs. Rowe here?
e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Pane chirevo chinoratidza kuti unonzwisisa kuti budget yegore rino haibvumidzi here?
e-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakadzivisa kuratidza kuora mwoyo kwakanyanya here?

e-01.title: Batanidza mitsara miviri yechizivisiro chelaibhurari kuti utarise hurongwa hwaBen
e-01.goal: Batanidza mitsara miviri yakasiyana yechizivisiro (nhoroondo yenguva dzose nechisingaenderani nevhiki ino), sarudza zuva nezuva kuti hurongwa hweshamwari yako hunoshanda here, uye umuudze muchiRungu.
e-01.material:
'Chizivisiro chiri pasuo relaibhurari yechikoro (chakanyorwa nemashoko chete, pasina mufananidzo):

Library
Open: Mon, Wed, Fri  3:00-4:00
This week: closed on Friday (cleaning day).

Shamwari yako Ben akati, "Let's go to the library on Thursday and on Friday this week!"'
e-01.thinking.0: Batanidza mitsara yakawanda yechizivisiro kuti usarudze
e-01.thinking.1: Tsvaga humbowo hwakasiyana pazuva rimwe nerimwe
e-01.s.s1.prompt: Ben anogona kushandisa laibhurari neChina neChishanu vhiki ino, sezvaakarongera here?
e-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa China neChishanu zvakasiyana, wobva waenzanisa zvinotaurwa nemutsara wega wega wechizivisiro nezvezuva iroro.
e-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti mutsara we 'Open' nemutsara we 'This week' vanoita mabasa akasiyana here.
e-01.s.s1.r.a: Pamwe hauna kuverenga mitsara yose miviri yechizivisiro. Tarisa kuti China riri pakati pemazuva akavhurika here, uye kuti pane nhoroondo yakakosha nezveChishanu here.
e-01.s.s1.r.c: Chishanu kazhinji chakavhurika, asi mutsara we 'This week' unotaura chimwe chinhu chakasiyana nezvevhiki ino.
e-01.s.s1.r.d: Tarisa zvakare kuti China riri murondedzero yemazuva akavhurika (Open) here.
e-01.s.s1.explain: China hariri pamazuva akavhurika (Mon, Wed, Fri), uye kunyange Chishanu kazhinji chakavhurika, vhiki ino 'closed on Friday'. Saka hapana zuva rinoshanda.
e-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mitsara yose yaunoda kutonga hurongwa hwaBen (China neChishanu).
e-01.s.s2.hint.0: Edza kubvisa mutsara mumwe nemumwe uone kuti zvinoomera here kutonga China kana Chishanu.
e-01.s.s2.hint.1: Chengeta mashoko aBen nemitsara yechizivisiro zvakasiyana.
e-01.s.s2.r.a: Izvi zvinoshandiswa kutonga China, asi mutsara uyu woga haukuudzi nezveChishanu chevhiki ino (kazhinji chakavhurika). Tarisa kuti unoda mumwe mutsara here.
e-01.s.s2.r.b: Unoda izvi kutonga Chishanu, asi mutsara uyu hauna chinotaura nezveChina. Tsvaga mutsara upi unokuita kuti utonge China.
e-01.s.s2.r.c: Musoro chete, saka hauna ruzivo nezvemazuva.
e-01.s.s2.r.d: Mutsara uyu ndiwo mashoko aBen. Mashoko ndechinhu chekutarisa, kwete humbowo.
e-01.s.s2.explain: Mutsara weOpen unoratidza kuti China harisi zuva rakavhurika, uye mutsara weThis week unoratidza kuti Chishanu chakavharwa vhiki ino. Mumwe wavo oga haagoni kutonga mazuva ose maviri. Kana wasarudza mumwe chete, tarisa kuti ndezvipi zuva rasara.
e-01.s.s3.prompt: Pindura Ben muchiRungu mumutsara mumwe kana miviri. Ipa chikonzero chekuti hauna kugona kuenda neChina nechikonzero chekuti hauna kugona kuenda neChishanu.
e-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kutanga, nyora mutsara mumwe unoudza Ben 'no, we can't.'
e-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mutsara mumwe wechikonzero cheChina nemumwe wechikonzero cheChishanu, mumwe nemumwe wakabatana nemutsara wechizivisiro.
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakapa chikonzero cheChina nechikonzero cheChishanu here?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Unogona kutaura kuti chikonzero chega chega chinobva pamutsara upi wechizivisiro here?
e-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Kana wakakurudzira rimwe zuva, wakatarisa here kuti ndezvirokwazvo zuva rakavhurika? (sarudzo)

e-02.title: Tsvaga mutsara unovhiringidza mumeseji yekukoka
e-02.goal: Tsvaga mitsara miviri isingaenderani mumeseji pfupi yekukoka, uye uinyore patsva kuti shamwari dzisavhiringidzike.
e-02.material: Iyi imeseji yakatumirwa naJun kuvaduku vekirasi yake. (Yakanyorwa nemashoko chete. Mutsara wega wega une nhamba.)
e-02.prereq.1: Zviito zviri nyore sa come / start the game
e-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe unogona kuvhiringidza shamwari. Mutsara usingaenderani nemumwe mutsara.
e-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa 'nguva yekusvika' ne 'nguva yekutanga'. Ndeipi inotanga?
e-02.s.s1.explain: Inoudza vanhu kuuya pa10, asi inoti mutambo unotanga pa9:30. Unogona kuchinja mutsara 3 kana 4. Mutsara 1 (paki neSvondo) nemutsara 2 (nzvimbo yepaki) hazvipesani nemumwe mutsara. Kana ukaenzanisa mitsara ine nhamba (nguva), unogona kuona kupesana.
e-02.s.s2.prompt: Chii chingaitika dai meseji iyi yatumirwa sezvayakaita?
e-02.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira shamwari inogamuchira meseji ichitarisa wachi ndokuita chaizvo zvainotaura.
e-02.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa: mutambo wakatotanga here shamwari iyoyo painosvika?
e-02.s.s2.o.a: Shamwari inouya pa10 inoshaya mutambo wakatotanga.
e-02.s.s2.o.b: Shamwari inouya pa9:30 inomirira mupaki isina munhu mutambo usatiwatanga.
e-02.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvinogona kuitika kushamwari inotenda kutanga pa9:30 ichisvika ipapo. Asi dambudziko rakananga zvikuru rinokonzerwa nekupesana ne 'come at 10' ndere a.
e-02.s.s2.o.c: Shamwari dzinoguma dzauya neMugovera panzvimbo yeSvondo.
e-02.s.s2.r.c: Zuva rakajeka kuti ndeSvondo. Dambudziko ndenguva.
e-02.s.s2.explain: Dambudziko rinoenderana nenguva yaunotevera pamaviri. Kana ukatevera 10, unoshaya mutambo (a); kana ukatevera 9:30, unovhiringidzika nokuti yakasiyana nezvinotaurwa nemumwe mutsara (b). Nenzira ipi neipi, zvinoitika nokuti nguva mbiri dzacho hadzienderani.
e-02.s.s2.acc.0: Shamwari inotenda kutanga pa9:30 ichisvika ipapo kuzomirira inyewo mhedzisiro chaiyo yekupesana. a ndeye shamwari yakatevera '10', uye b ndeye shamwari yakatevera '9:30'.
e-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora patsva mitsara miviri (nguva yekusvika nenguva yekutanga mutambo) muchiRungu kuti nguva dzienderane.
e-02.s.s3.hint.0: Unogona kuchinja imwe chete yenguva mbiri. Sarudza kutanga kuti ndeipi yekuchinja.
e-02.s.s3.hint.1: Isa nguva yekusvika pamberi penguva yekutanga, uye nyora nguva dzose mbiri sedzenhamba padivi nepadivi kuti uenzanise.
e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Pakati penguva mbiri dzawakanyora, ndeipi iri nekukurumidza? Nguva yekusvika inotanga here?
e-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafungidzira here kuti shamwari ingaita sei mushure mekuverenga meseji iyi?

e-04.title: Jun anoda chii? Gadzirisa pfungwa dzako sezvo zvinoratidza zvichiwedzerwa
e-04.goal: Pazuva rega rega apo chiratidzo chekutaura chichiwedzerwa, fungidzira zvakare zvinodiwa nemutauri, uye utsanangure kuti kufungidzira kwako kwakachinja sei.
e-04.material: Kumba, Jun ari kutaura naamai vake. Mashoko ake acharatidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva.
e-04.prereq.0: Mazwi akareruka sa small, hurt, closed
e-04.s.s1.prompt: Verenga mashoko aJun chidimbu chimwe panguva, uye nguva dzose fungidzira kuti Jun anoda chii.
e-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga izwi rimwe idzva muchidimbu ichi.
e-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa imwe neimwe kuti kufungidzira kwako kwekare kunokodzera chiratidzo chitsva here.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ndekupi kufungidzira kwakanyanya kunzwisisika kwezvinodiwa naJun kuna amai vake, kubva pamutsara uyu woga?
e-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Haugone kuziva chaizvo kubva pamutsara mumwe. Angada shangu itsva, kana kuti angoti chokwadi chete.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Hapana chinhu muzviratidzo nezvekirasi yeP.E. kana kusiya.
e-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Anotarisira kuti amai vake vamutengere shangu itsva.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Jun: "They hurt when I run. We have P.E. (physical education) class tomorrow."
e-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Verenga chiratidzo chitsva uye ufungidzire zvakare zvinodiwa naJun.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.after: 'Zvinorwadza' ne 'P.E. mangwana' zvinoita kuti zvijeke kuti anoda kuti zvigadziriswe pasati pasvika mangwana. Kana wakafunga panhanho yekutanga kuti 'ari kungotaura chokwadi', unofanira kugadzirisa fungidziro yako pano.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Anoda kugadzirisa kuti tsoka dzake dzisarwadze pasati pasvika kirasi ye P.E. mangwana.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kutaura kuti tsoka dzake dzinorwadza uye ane P.E. mangwana chiratidzo chekuti anoda kuti zvigadziriswe. Izvo zvaigoneka panhanho yekutanga, asi zvino hazvienderani nezviratidzo.
e-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Haana kumbotaura kuti anoda kusiya. Kuverenga sekutsvaga mhinduro kubva ku 'zvinorwadza' ne 'P.E. mangwana' kuri padyo nezviratidzo.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Verenga chiratidzo chekupedzisira uye ufungidzire zvichaitwa naJun.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Chitoro chakavharwa nhasi, saka 'shangu itsva nhasi' yakavharirwa. Zvirongwa sekuenda kuchimwe chitoro kana kutaura nezveshangu dzeshamwari zvose zvinoenderana nechiratidzo chitsva. Kana wakangofunga nezveshangu itsva, unofanira kuchinja chirongwa chako chekutenga nhasi.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Anoenda kuchitoro nhasi uye anotenga shangu itsva.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hazvienderani nechiratidzo chekuti chitoro chakavharwa nhasi.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Anokumbira amai vake kuti vaende kuchimwe chitoro mangwanani mangwana.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ichi zvakare chirongwa chinogoneka. Asi pfungwa yaanouya nayo Jun pakupedzisira inotaura nezveshamwari.
e-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Anofunga nezvekukwereta shangu kubva kushamwari ine saizi yetsoka yakafanana.
e-04.s.s1.reflect: Fungidziro yako yakachinja panhanho imwe neimwe here? Kana yakachinja, taura mutsara mumwe waiva chikonzero.
e-04.s.s2.prompt: Chiratidzo chipi chinoita kuti chido chaJun chiverengwe sekuchinja kubva ku 'kungotaura' kuenda ku 'kuchigadzirisa kusati kwasvika mangwana'?
e-04.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga zviratidzo zvitatu nenhevedzano uye utsvage pakatanga kudzikira nhamba yefungidziro dzinogoneka.
e-04.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga uchibvisa chiratidzo chimwe nechimwe uye uedze kana zvinoreva 'anoda kuchigadzirisa' zvichiri kuvapo.
e-04.s.s2.r.b: Mutsara uyu waivapo kubva pakutanga, uye pachawo waibvumira fungidziro dzakati wandei.

e-04.s.s2.explain: 'Zvinorwadza' ne 'P.E. mangwana' zvinogadzira dambudziko rine nguva yakatarwa, saka Jun anoverengwa seanoda kuti rigadziriswe.

e-05.title: Kuudza vanhu vakasiyana nezvemamiriro ezvinhu akafanana
e-05.goal: Nyora muChirungu nezvemamiriro ezvinhu akafanana (kusvika kuklabhu nekuda kwekuenda kuna chiremba wemazino) kumudzidzisi nekushamwari, imwe neimwe ine inzwi nehurefu hunokodzera.
e-05.material: Nhasi pane kirabhu yeChirungu panguva ye 3:30, asi une nguva yekuenda kuna chiremba wemazino panguva imwechete, saka haugoni kuenda. Unofanira kuudza mudzidzisi wekirabhu, Ms. Han, nemashoko, uye shamwari yekirabhu imwechete nemashoko mapfupi.
e-05.thinking.0: Enzanisa uye usarudze mazwi zvichienderana nemunhu nemamiriro ezvinhu
e-05.thinking.1: Nyora kuti ugutse mamiriro ekuremekedza nehurefu
e-05.prereq.0: Mazwi ekuremekedza sa could / would / please
e-05.s.s1.prompt: Ndeipi meseji yakanakisa yekutumira kuna Ms. Han? (Uchanyorera shamwari yako panhanho inotevera.)
e-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga kukumbira ruregerero kana chikumbiro mumeseji imwe neimwe.
e-05.s.s1.hint.1: Dzienzanise uchifungidzira kuti mudzidzisi angazvinzwa sei paanogamuchira meseji imwe neimwe.
e-05.s.s1.r.b: Chikonzero nemamiriro ezvinhu zvakajeka, asi pasina kukumbira ruregerero kana chikumbiro zvinogona kunzwika sekuzivisa mudzidzisi bedzi.
e-05.s.s1.r.c: Inopa chikonzero asi inonzwika sekusundira mhosva kune mumwe, izvo zvingagumbura mumwe munhu.
e-05.s.s1.r.d: Inzwi rine ushamwari asi richiri rekuremekedza. Girama zvakare yakanaka.
e-05.s.s1.explain: a ne d dzine kukumbira ruregerero, chikonzero, nechikumbiro. a i yepamutemo zvakanyanya uye d i yakareruka, asi zvose zvinoremekedza. b yakajeka uye inoremekedza, asi pasina kukumbira ruregerero kana chikumbiro inogona kuverengwa seisingaremekedzi zvikuru. Mu c, inzwi rekusundira mhosva kune mumwe rinogona kuita kuti mumwe asanzwe zvakanaka. Mazinga ekuremekedza anotarisirwa anosiyana nechikoro nemudzidzisi.
e-05.s.s1.acc.0: Kana wakavavarira nemudzidzisi, inzwi rine ushamwari asi rekuremekedza sa d rinokodzerawo. a i chirevo chepamutemo zvikuru.
e-05.s.s1.acc.1: b ine chikonzero nemamiriro ezvinhu zvakajeka uye zita rekuremekedza (Ms. Han), saka inogona se chiziviso pfupi. Asi pasina kukumbira ruregerero kana chikumbiro, inogona kuverengwa seisingaremekedzi zvikuru kupfuura a ne d.
e-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora iwe pachako meseji kuna Ms. Han. Taura kuti haugone kuuya nechikonzero (kuenda kuna chiremba wemazino), uye usanganisire chirevo chekuremekedza (kukumbira ruregerero kana chikumbiro).
e-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wafunga zvaungawedzera dai uchitaura nemudzidzisi wako muchiKorea, wobva wawana kuti ungataura zvinoreva izvozvo sei muChirungu.
e-05.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kunyora nenhevedzano iyi: mutsara wekusauya, mutsara wechikonzero, mutsara wechikumbiro.
e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Inzwi iri here risingagumbure mudzidzisi paanoriverenga? Izwi ripi rinoita basa iri?
e-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Kana wawedzera chaunoda (sekuwana zvinhu), zvinonzwika sechikumbiro here?
e-05.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino i meseji kushamwari yekirabhu imwechete. Nyora mamiriro ezvinhu akafanana muchipfupi mumazwi 18 kana mashoma, nenzwi risina kuremekedzwa zvikuru. (Usashandise mazwi epamutemo sa Dear kana I'm afraid.)
e-05.s.s3.hint.0: Chengeta ruzivo rwaunofanira kuchengeta bedzi kubva mumeseji yako kumudzidzisi (chikonzero, uye kuti haugone kuuya).
e-05.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa contractions (can't) kana mazwi pfupi, uye uverenge mazwi.
e-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kana ukaienzanisa nezvawakanyorera mudzidzisi, mazwi api akanyangarika uye api akaramba?
e-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kunyangwe iri pfupi, shamwari yako inogona kuziva chikonzero here?
e-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Inzwi rine ushamwari rine kukumbira ruregerero nemubvunzo.

e-06.title: Tsvaga mitsara ine zvirongwa zvinopindirana mumeseji yeboka
e-06.goal: Tsvaga mitsara miviri yezvirongwa mumeseji yeboka isingaenderani, tsanangura kuvhiringidzika kwainogona kukonzera, uye uinyore patsva.
e-06.material: Iyi i meseji yakatumirwa muchat yeboka nemutungamiriri wepurojekiti yeboka resainzi. (Mutsara mumwe nemumwe une nhamba. Nguva dzemasikati dzakanyorwa se p.m.)
e-06.prereq.0: by / before / after + zuva kana nguva
e-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe unogona kukonzera dambudziko kuvanhu veboka vanotevera chirongwa. Ndiwo mutsara une urongwa hwenguva husingaenderani nemumwe mutsara.
e-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga mitsara yose ine nguva uye urongedze nguva dzacho nenhevedzano yenguva.
e-06.s.s1.hint.1: Chinotanga ndechipi: nguva yekupedzisira yekutumira kana nguva yekubatanidza?
e-06.s.s1.explain: Nguva yekubatanidza i China 4:30 p.m., asi nguva yekupedzisira yezvikamu i China 9:00 p.m. Nguva yekupedzisira i gare gare kupfuura nguva yekubatanidza, saka mitsara miviri (mutsara 2 ne mutsara 3) inopokana. Mitsara 1 ne 4 inotaura nezvenguva yekupedzisira yeLugwaro nekudhinda, saka haipokani.
e-06.s.s2.prompt: Chaizvo chingaitika kana vanhu vakatevera meseji iyi sezvainge yakaita?
e-06.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti mumwe webhoka anotumira chikamu chake chaizvo 'China usiku'.
e-06.s.s2.o.a: Chikamu chinodiwa pa 9 chingave chisati chasvika kana zvikamu zvichibatanidzwa pa 4:30.
e-06.s.s2.o.b: Zvikamu zvese zvinosvika zvisati zvabatanidzwa, saka posita inopera nekukurumidza.
e-06.s.s2.r.b: Basa rekubatanidza i pa 4:30 p.m., uye zvikamu zvinogamuchirwa kusvika 9:00 p.m. Enzanisa nguva zvakare.
e-06.s.s2.o.c: Hapana nguva yasara yekudhinda pamberi pekirasi yeLugwaro.
e-06.s.s2.r.c: Dambudziko i urongwa mukati meChina. Nguva ichiripo kusvika mangwanani eLugwaro.
e-06.s.s2.explain: Kubatanidza kunotanga, asi zvikamu zvinogamuchirwa kusvika gare gare, saka chikamu chakatumirwa gare gare chingasiiwa.
e-06.s.s3.prompt: Nyora patsva mutsara mumwe wezvinopokana (kana yose miviri) muChirungu. Ita kuti nguva namazuva zvienderane.
e-06.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza nguva yemutsara upi pakati pemiviri yaunofanira kuchinja.
e-06.s.s3.hint.1: Mushure mekuchinja, verenga zvakare kuti utarise kuti urongwa 'nguva yekupedzisira yezvikamu → kubatanidza → kudhinda' hwakarurama nenguva.
e-06.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Please send me your part by ...
e-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Nguva yekupedzisira yekugamuchira zvikamu inouya pamberi penguva yekubatanidza here? Enzanisa nguva mbiri senhamba.
e-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Nguva ichiripo here pamberi penguva yekupedzisira yemangwanani eLugwaro?
e-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ndakaisa nguva yekubatanidza gare gare uye ndikawedzera chikonzero.

e-07.title: Batanidza zviziviso zviviri kuti uverenge nguva yekubva kwebhazi
e-07.goal: Batanidza zviziviso zviviri zvakaiswa pamazuva akasiyana (nguva yekutanga nekuchinja gare gare) kuti uverenge nguva itsva yekubva, uye ugadzirise kusanzwisisa kweshamwari uchishandisa humbowo.
e-07.material:
Zviziviso zviviri zvakaiswa pabhodhi rekuziviswa pabhazi stop. (Zvakanyorwa nemazwi bedzi.)

Chiziviso A (chakaiswa Muvhuro): "Bus 5 leaves at 7:40 a.m."
Chiziviso B (chakaiswa Chitatu): "From Thursday, Bus 5 will leave 10 minutes earlier. Please be at the stop on time."

Shamwari yako Hana: "Bus 5 leaves at 7:50 on Thursday."
Shamwari yako Jae: "Then on Friday it leaves at the same time as on Thursday."
e-07.thinking.0: Batanidza ruzivo rwakawanda kuti uwane mhedziso
e-07.thinking.1: Nzwisisa kuti chiziviso chekupedzisira chinochinja sei chiziviso chekutanga
e-07.prereq.0: Mazwi sa earlier / later / from + zuva
e-07.s.s1.prompt: Kutonga kubva pazviziviso zviviri, Hana akarurama here?
e-07.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa mazuva akaiswa zviziviso zviviri. Chipi chiri gare gare?
e-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana earlier zvichireva 'nekukurumidza' kana 'gare gare', uye uverenge kubva pa 7:40.
e-07.s.s1.o.a: Akarurama. Kuwedzera maminitsi 10 aB ku 7:40 yaA kunopa 7:50.
e-07.s.s1.r.a: Ungadai wakaverenga earlier sekunge i 'gare gare'. Tarisa zvakare zvinoreva earlier.
e-07.s.s1.o.b: Haana kururama. B inoti inobva maminitsi 10 kare, saka i 7:30.
e-07.s.s1.o.c: Hatigoni kuziva. Hatigoni kusarudza kuti chiziviso chipi chakarurama.
e-07.s.s1.r.c: Zviziviso zviviri hazvipokani. B i chiziviso chiri gare gare chinochinja nguva yaA.
e-07.s.s1.explain: Chiziviso B chakaiswa gare gare uye chinoti maminitsi 10 kare kupfuura nguva yaA. Maminitsi 10 pamberi pe 7:40 i 7:30.
e-07.s.s2.prompt: Jae akati, "On Friday it's the same time as Thursday." Unogona kutonga sei chirevo ichi kubva pazviziviso?
e-07.s.s2.hint.0: Edza kushandura 'on Thursday' ne 'from Thursday' uye uenzanise kana zvinoreva zvichichinja.
e-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga mazwi muchiziviso anoratidza kuti inopera rini.
e-07.s.s2.o.a: 'From Thursday' zvinoreva kuenderera kubva China zvichienda mberi, saka Chishanu chakafanana neChina.
e-07.s.s2.o.b: 'From Thursday' zvinoreva kuti zuva reChina bedzi rinochinja.
e-07.s.s2.r.b: 'From Thursday' ne 'on Thursday' zvakasiyana. 'From' inoratidza poindi yekutanga.
e-07.s.s2.o.c: Chishanu hachitaurwi zvakananga muchiziviso, saka zvinoita sekuti unofanira kutarisa.
e-07.s.s2.r.c: Kungwarira kunonzwisisika. Asi chirevo 'From Thursday' chatosanganisira mazuva anotevera.
e-07.s.s2.explain: 'From Thursday' zvinoreva kuti nguva itsva inoshanda kutanga China. Kana pasina izwi rinotaura kuti inopera rini, Chishanu chakafanana. Kufunga kubvunza vashandi nekuti hazvina kunyorwa zvakananga kunonzwisisikawo.
e-07.s.s2.acc.0: Kuda kubvunza vashandi nekuti Chishanu hachina kunyorwa zvakananga muchiziviso kunonzwisisikawo. Asi 'From Thursday' kazhinji zvinoreva kuti inoenderera gare gare.
e-07.s.s3.prompt: Pindura Hana muChirungu. Taura nguva yekubva kwebhazi China, uye upe chikonzero chinobva pazviziviso.
e-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nenguva yeChiziviso A, uye unyore zvinotaura Chiziviso B kuti zvinochinja.
e-07.s.s3.hint.1: Wedzera mutsara mumwe pa 'sei 7:50 isina kururama.'
e-07.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: I think it leaves at ... because ...
e-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Zvinojeka here kuti humbowo hwako hunobva muchiziviso chipi pamaviri?

e-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro pfupi inopikisa kubva pazvinoreva izwi.

e-08.title: Nyora chiziviso chekirabhu chisingavhiringidze
e-08.goal: Tsanangura kuti sei chiziviso chisina kujeka chinovhiringidza, uye unyore patsva zvirimo zvakafanana muChirungu kuti ani nani anochiverenga anonzwisisa pasina kukanganisa.

Ichi chiziviso chakaiswa pabhodhi rekuziviswa.

"Art Club meeting this Friday or next week at 3 or 4 in room 2 or the gym. Bring something."

Shamwari dzakaverenga chiziviso ichi dzakaenda kunzvimbo dzakasiyana uye dzakasasangana.
e-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ratidza zvikamu zvechiziviso zvine 'or', uye zvikamu zvine mazwi asina kujeka asingajekesi zvinoreva (sa something).
e-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa chikamu nechikamu kana muverengi anogona kutenda chinhu chimwe chete uye otevedza.
e-08.s.s1.r.a: Chokwadi zuva harina kujeka. Tarisa kana zvimwe zvinhu zvichibvumira muverengi kuita chinhu chimwe chete zvakare.
e-08.s.s1.r.b: Chokwadi nguva haina kujeka. Tarisa kana zvimwe zvinhu zvichibvumira muverengi kuita chinhu chimwe chete zvakare.
e-08.s.s1.r.c: Chokwadi nzvimbo haina kujeka. Tarisa kana zvimwe zvinhu zvichibvumira muverengi kuita chinhu chimwe chete zvakare.
e-08.s.s1.r.d: Chokwadi zvekuuya nazvo hazvina kujeka. Tarisa kana zvimwe zvinhu zvichibvumira muverengi kuita chinhu chimwe chete zvakare.
e-08.s.s1.r.e: Zvinojeka kuti musangano ndewaani. Sarudza zvikamu zvaungaverenga nenzira mbiri kana zvakawanda bedzi.
e-08.s.s1.explain: Zuva, nguva, nenzvimbo zvose hazvina kujeka nekuda kwe 'or', uye zvekuuya nazvo hazvina kujeka nekuti hauzivi kuti 'something' i chii. Kana wakasarudza zvimwe bedzi, edza zvakare kana muverengi anogona kuita chinhu chimwe chete pazvinhu zvawakasiya.
e-08.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva chiziviso chemusangano mumwechete muChirungu pasina kusanzwisisa. Sarudza uye unyore zuva, nguva, nzvimbo, nezvekuuya nazvo.
e-08.s.s2.hint.0: Mupfungwa dzako, gadzira tafura apo unogadzirisa chinhu chimwe chimwe chezuva, nguva, nzvimbo, nezvekuuya nazvo.

e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Kunyangwe kushamwari iri kuchiona kekutanga, inogona kuziva kwekuenda here?
e-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Zuva (zuva) nenguva zvose zvakatarwa kuchinhu chimwe here?
e-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Hunhu hwekushamwaridzana. 'or' yezvekuuya nazvo isarudzo chete, haisi kusajeka.

e-11.title: Kuongorora chirevo che 'Zvirevo zvakaderera, saka imhosva yeWi-Fi'
e-11.goal: Ongorora kuti kufunga chikonzero nemhedzisiro mutsamba yepepanhau yechikoro kwakakwana here, sarudza ruzivo runodikanwa kutarisa chirevo, uye nyora nehunhu mhinduro yekupikisa kumunyori muChirungu.
e-11.material:
Tsamba yemuverengi mupepanhau yechikoro (chinyorwa chakafungidzirwa):

"Last year, our school's average English score was 78. This year, after the school started free Wi-Fi, it fell to 72. So the Wi-Fi caused the drop. Therefore we should turn the Wi-Fi off."
e-11.prereq.0: Mazwi echikonzero nemhedzisiro akaita se therefore / so / caused
e-11.prereq.1: Kusabvumirana nehunhu (I see your point, however ...)
e-11.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe muchinyorwa ichi unotaura sokunge chokwadi chakasimba kunyange humbowo hushoma.
e-11.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa mutsetse wese kuita 'chinhu chakaitika' kana 'chirevo chechikonzero kana chekuita'.
e-11.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kuti mitsetse yezvirevo inobva pamitsetse yezvokwadi iri pamberi payo yoga here.
e-11.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 ('So the Wi-Fi caused the drop.') unosvetuka kubva ku 'zvakaitika mushure' kuenda ku 'ndicho chikonzero.' 'We should turn it off' iri pamutsetse 4 haina humbowo zvakare, asi inotsamira pakusvetuka kuri pamutsetse 3. Mitsetse 1 ne2 mashoko ezvokwadi pamusoro pemamaki nenguva.
e-11.s.s2.prompt: Ruzivo rupi rwaizokubatsira kutarisa 'The Wi-Fi is the cause of the score drop'? Sarudza zvose zvinoshanda.
e-11.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira zvikonzero zviviri kunze kweWi-Fi zvinogona kuchinja mamaki.
e-11.s.s2.hint.1: Tonga kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe yaigona kubatsira kuparadzanisa kuti Wi-Fi here kana chimwe chikonzero ndicho chiri chikonzero.
e-11.s.s2.o.a: Kuti mamaki eChirungu akachinja sei mugore rimwechete kuchikoro chimwe chisina Wi-Fi
e-11.s.s2.r.a: Kuenzanisa nzira yakanaka. Tarisawo kuti unogona kutarisa misiyano mukuoma kwebvunzo kana mapoka evadzidzi here.
e-11.s.s2.o.b: Kuti bvunzo yeChirungu yegore rino yakanga yakaoma kupfuura yegore rapfuura here
e-11.s.s2.r.b: Kana bvunzo yakachinja, chikonzero chakakosha. Tarisawo kuenzanisa nezvimwe zvikoro nepoka revadzidzi.
e-11.s.s2.r.c: Kuti vadzidzi vanofarira kirasi zvakadii kungabatana nemamaki, asi hakugoni kuparadzanisa kuti Wi-Fi ndicho chikonzero here.
e-11.s.s2.r.d: Mutengo unobatana nesarudzo yekuiisa, asi hauna chekuita nenei mamaki akadzika.
e-11.s.s2.o.e: Kuti vadzidzi vakashandisa mafoni avo mukirasi yeChirungu here
e-11.s.s2.r.e: Iruzivo runotarisa nzira. Tarisawo zvimwe zvikonzero (bvunzo, poka revadzidzi, zvimwe zvikoro).
e-11.s.s2.o.f: Kuti vadzidzi vegore rino ndipoka rakasiyana nevadzidzi vegore rapfuura here (unyanzvi, huwandu hwekudzidza, nezvimwe)
e-11.s.s2.explain: Kuenzanisa nezvimwe zvikoro (a), kutarisa kuoma kwebvunzo (b), nekutarisa kuti yakashandiswa mukirasi here (e) nemisiyano mupoka revadzidzi (f) kunokubvumidza kuparadzanisa kuti Wi-Fi here kana chimwe chikonzero ndicho chikonzero. Huwandu hwevadzidzi vanofarira kirasi nemutengo wekuisa hazvibatani zvakananga nechikonzero.
e-11.s.s2.acc.0: Kuenzanisa nezvimwe zvikoro nekutarisa kuoma kwebvunzo kwoga kwatova kwakakwana kubatsira kuparadzanisa zvimwe zvikonzero.
e-11.s.s2.acc.1: Kana ukatarisawo kuti yakashandiswa mukirasi here, unogona kuona nzira Wi-Fi yainge yashanda nayo.
e-11.s.s2.acc.2: Misiyano mupoka revadzidzi zvakare chimwe chikonzero chakajairika chekuchinja kwemamaki.
e-11.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro yekupikisa ine mitsara 2-3 kumunyori muChirungu. Bvuma chokwadi chekuti mamaki akadzika, asi tsanangura kuti chirevo chekuti Wi-Fi ndicho chikonzero hachisati chakwana, uye ipa nzira imwe yekutarisa kana chimwe chikonzero.
e-11.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga, mumutsara mumwe, wabvume chikamu chawakarurama munyori (mamaki akadzika).
e-11.s.s3.hint.1: Wobva wanyora chikonzero chimwe chakananga cheka kuti kuzvidaidza 'chikonzero' hakukwani (chimwe chikonzero ipi kana kuenzanisa kupi).
e-11.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: I see your point, but ...
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kunyora kwako kwakabvuma chokwadi chekuti mamaki akadzika here?
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakapa chikonzero chimwe chekuti kutaura zvakasimba kuti ndicho 'chikonzero' hakukwani here?
e-11.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Hunhu hwekutaura hunoratidza kukanganisa kwepfungwa pasina kurwisa munyori here?

e-12.title: Kana 'It's fine.' isiri fine: kugadzira nhaurirano
e-12.goal: Tonga kuti mazwi akaita se 'It's fine.' angasareva zvaanotaura zvakananga, uye gadzira nhaurirano pfupi yeChirungu pamusoro pemamiriro akadaro kuti usangane nemamiriro.
e-12.material: A anoti kuna B, "I'm sorry I forgot to call you last night." B anogona kupindura izvi nenzira dzakasiyana. (Dzakanyorwa nemazwi chete.)
e-12.thinking.0: Fungidzira chinangwa chakavanzika kubva pahunhu nemamiriro
e-12.prereq.1: Mazwi akaita se Are you sure? / You sound ...
e-12.s.s1.prompt: Pakati pemhinduro dzaB, ipi inogona kuva yekunyepedzera kuti zvakanaka kana zvisiri zvakanaka chaizvo?
e-12.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mhinduro imwe neimwe nenzwi, uye fungidzira kuti munhu akanaka chaizvo angaitaura nenzira iyoyo here.
e-12.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti mhinduro imwe neimwe inosanganisira 'chikonzero chekuti zvakanaka' kana 'chinhu chinodiwa' here, kana kuti izvozvo hazvipo.
e-12.s.s1.r.a: Inotaura zvakajairika ichipa chikonzero. Chikonzero chekuti zvakanaka chiri mumutsara.
e-12.s.s1.r.c: Ingaitwa nokuti inotaurwa zvakasimba zvikuru, asi zvakaoma kutonga manzwiro kubva pamutsara woga.
e-12.s.s1.r.d: Inoti zvakanaka, asi inotaurawo zvaanoda. Inovanza zvishoma.
e-12.s.s1.explain: Kana munhu achingoti 'It's fine.' pfupi, yakati sandara, hapana chikonzero kana manzwiro zvinooneka, saka zviri nyore kuiverenga sekuvanza manzwiro emukati. Asi haugoni kuva nechokwadi kubva pamutsara woga, uye unofanira kutarisa hunhu hwekutaura nemamiriro pamwe chete.
e-12.s.s1.acc.0: 'totally' yakasimbiswa zvakanyanya inogona chaizvo kuva chiratidzo chekufukidza kuti zvisiri zvakanaka.
e-12.s.s1.acc.1: Kukahadzika pa 'Just...' chiratidzo chekuti munhu haasi akanaka zvachose. Asi hazvidaro zvakanyanya, nokuti munhu ari kutaura chikamu chekuti anonzwa sei.
e-12.s.s2.prompt:
Gadzira nhaurirano yeChirungu inosangana nemamiriro ari pazasi. Tanga mutsara mumwe nomumwe ne A: kana B:, uye nyora mitsara inosvika 4.
Mamiriro 1) B anoti zvakanaka nemazwi akaita se 'fine' kana 'okay', asi chaizvo anoratidzika kuva akatsamwa.
Mamiriro 2) A anocherekedza izvi uye anobvunza zvinyoro (shandisa mucherechedzo wemubvunzo).
Mamiriro 3) Pakupedzisira, B anotaura zvishoma zvaanonzwa chaizvo.
e-12.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza mamiriro mumwe (kukanganwa chitsidzo, chipo, mhedzisiro yebvunzo, nezvimwe).
e-12.s.s2.hint.1: Ita kuti mhinduro yekutanga yaB ive pfupi, uye utange mubvunzo waA pfupi, senge 'Are you sure?'
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Unonzwa munhaurirano here kuti mazwi aB ('fine') nemanzwiro chaiwo aB zvakasiyana? Mumutsara upi?
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mubvunzo waA unonyorova, usina mhosva here?
e-12.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Mumutsara wekupedzisira, B akataura zvishoma zvaanonzwa chaizvo here?
e-12.s.s2.modelNote.0: Kuyerera umo manzwiro chaiwo anoonekwa mumamiriro ekukumbira ruregerero.
e-12.s.s2.modelNote.1: Nhaurirano inosangana nemamiriro akafanana nemamiriro akasiyana.
